mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(h.time), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "DAY", COUNT(*) AS "CNT" FROM apm_db_info a JOIN ora_alarm_history h ON h.db_id = a.db_id WHERE h.time > SYSDATE - 30 AND a.instance_name = #{inst} AND h.name = #{alarm} GROUP BY TRUNC(h.time) ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', b.time), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "DAY", COUNT(*) AS "CNT" FROM ${schema}.ora_alarm_history b JOIN apm_db_info a ON a.db_id = b.db_id WHERE a.instance_name = #{inst} AND b.name = #{alarm} AND b.time >= date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') GROUP BY date_trunc('day', b.time) ORDER BY 1 DESC
